The thesis

AI can move the work forward. It cannot move the decision.

Every useful output has a source, an accountable specialist, a defined boundary, and a moment where a person decides what happens next.

01 / The route

Make every handoff visible.

Instead of asking one generalist prompt to design a product, the system moves approved work between specialist agents and explicit decision gates.

SYSTEM: AGENT → SKILL → GATESCROLL OR USE CONTROLS
01 / DISCOVER

Find the facts.

Create evidence, unknowns, and research prompts without inventing certainty.

Agent: DiscoverG1
02 / DEFINE

Frame the need.

Convert evidence into a problem frame and prioritised requirements.

Agent: DefineG2
03 / DEVELOP

Shape the flow.

Plan journeys, states, content and interface logic.

Agent: DevelopG3
04 / DELIVER

Give it form.

Build the visual system, prototype behaviour and specifications.

Agent: DeliverG4
05 / BUILD

Make it work.

Implement the final responsive experience and its edge states.

Agent: BuildG5
06 / VALIDATE

Test the claim.

Review usability, accessibility and release-readiness evidence.

Agent: ValidateG6

03 / Project structure

A workspace with clear boundaries.

The structure is deliberately legible: methods, decisions and outputs are separate so the path can be inspected or resumed.

  1. INPUTOriginal human sources stay unchanged.
  2. METHODAgents, skills and gates declare what is allowed.
  3. OUTPUTArtefacts remain grouped by the phase that owns them.

This is live code, rather than an image, so it stays readable, selectable and responsive at every size.

04 / The review contract

The workflow knows when to stop.

Completeness is not approval. A human gate gives the work a clear owner at every consequential moment.

The named artefacts are accepted at their current version. Only then can the next phase become eligible.

Feedback goes to the affected skill, then only its dependent outputs are regenerated before review returns to the same gate.

The workflow stops. It never silently invents a workaround, scope change or release decision.

05 / Final design output

The brief, made tangible.

A working Smart Expense Tracker prototype, designed through the workflow above. It uses illustrative INR data only and never connects to financial accounts.
